def swap_list(lst):
    """Interchange the first and last elements in a list."""
    if not lst:  # Handle empty list safely
        return []
    
    n = len(lst)
    if n == 1:
        return lst
    
    # Swap using slicing (creates new list, doesn't modify original)
    swapped_list = [lst[-1]] + lst[1:-1] + [lst[0]]
    return swapped_list
